description: Defines the interface for URLRequestContextGetter, a class responsible for retrieving and managing URLRequestContext objects within the Chromium networking code. It includes methods for obtaining the context, managing shutdown notifications, and observer management.

classes.name: URLRequestContextGetter
classes.description: Interface class for retrieving URLRequestContext, with lifecycle management and observer support.

methods.name: GetURLRequestContext
methods.description: Returns the associated URLRequestContext; must be called on the network thread.

methods.name: GetNetworkTaskRunner
methods.description: Returns the task runner for the network thread where IO happens.

methods.name: NotifyContextShuttingDown
methods.description: Notifies observers that the context is shutting down; should be called once before teardown.

methods.name: AddObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer to monitor shutdown events; must be called on the network thread.

methods.name: RemoveObserver
methods.description: Removes an observer; must be called on the network thread.

methods.name: OnDestruct
methods.description: Ensures deletion on the thread where IO occurs.
